globalSearch.description: Install at least one source to use global search.

statistics.title: No reading stats yet
statistics.description: Statistics are collected as you read.

manga.title: Manga not found
manga.description: It may have been removed. Go back and open it from a source again.

settings.comingSoon: These settings arrive in a later version.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Catppuccin flavor used across the app.

accent.label: Accent color
accent.description: Used for buttons, highlights and progress.

about.license: Matane is free software under the GNU GPL v3.
about.licensesNone: The license list is created when the app is built.
about.licenseNoText: Licensed under {{license}}; the package ships no license file.

advanced.devDescription: Load an extension from a folder (its project or a built bundle). It reloads automatically when `mr-ext build` updates it.
advanced.logLevelHint: How much goes into the log file. "Debug" helps when reporting a problem.
advanced.filesHint: Crash reports stay on this computer; nothing is sent anywhere.
advanced.debugInfoHint: Versions, installed extensions and the last log lines, without your home folder or URL tokens. Paste it into a bug report.

library.categoriesHint: Group your library into tabs. Drag to reorder. Manga without a category are under "Default".
library.deleteDescription: Its manga stay in your library (under "Default" if this was their only category).

downloads.moveDescription_one: {{count}} downloaded chapter ({{size}}) is in the current folder. Move it to the new one? Otherwise it stays where it is and can still be read.
downloads.moveDescription_other: {{count}} downloaded chapters ({{size}}) are in the current folder. Move them to the new one? Otherwise they stay where they are and can still be read.
downloads.formatHint: CBZ is one file per chapter with ComicInfo.xml; a folder keeps the plain images.
downloads.limitHint: Past it, automatic downloads stop; you can still download chapters yourself.
downloads.parallelHint: Each chapter downloads 4 pages at a time; sources' rate limits still apply.
downloads.resumeOnStartHint: Otherwise unfinished downloads wait, paused, until you resume them.
downloads.aheadHint: While reading a manga in your library, download the next unread chapters.
downloads.deleteAfterReadHint: Delete a chapter's download once you finish reading it.
downloads.delayHint: Wait until this many later chapters are read too.
downloads.excludeCategoriesHint: Manga in a selected category never lose their downloads.

updates.title: Library updates
updates.intervalHint: Also checks when the app opens if the time has passed. Offline, it waits.
updates.skipHint: Skip rules apply to library and category checks, not to a single manga.
updates.skipUnread: Skip manga with many unread chapters
updates.metadataHint: Cover, description and status; your library title stays.
updates.notifyHint: Always for automatic checks; for manual ones when the window is in the background.
updates.autoDownloadHint: After a check, unread new chapters are queued. The download size limit applies.
updates.categoriesHint: Include: only manga in included categories. Exclude: never manga in this category.

system.title: System
system.closeToTrayHint: Closing the window keeps Matane running in the tray, so downloads and update checks go on.
system.noTray: Your desktop has no system tray (on GNOME, install the AppIndicator extension).
system.openAtLoginHint: Open Matane when you sign in.
system.startHiddenHint: At login, stay in the tray without opening the window. Needs close to tray.

data.cacheSizeHint: Pages you read are kept for reading offline; the least recently read go first past the limit.
data.browseCoversHint: {{used}} · covers of manga outside the library
data.clearPagesDescription: Chapters you read but did not download will need the internet again. Downloads stay.
data.clearCoversDescription: They are fetched again when shown. Library covers stay.
data.clearStatsHint: Forgets reading time and sessions. Progress, read chapters and history stay.
data.clearStatsDescription: Reading time, streaks and the statistics page start over. This cannot be undone.

updater.title: App updates
updater.dev: Updates are off in development builds.
updater.notifyOnly: This installation cannot update itself: download the new version from the release page.
updater.autoHint: Updates come from GitHub releases; nothing else is sent.
updater.mode: When a new version is out
updater.modeHint: Checked at start and every 6 hours.
updater.channelHint: Beta gets pre-releases too. For now, every release is a beta.
updater.packageManager: Installed through a package manager: update Matane there.

languages.label: Content languages
languages.hint: Only extensions and sources in these languages are shown. By default: the app language and English.

nsfw.label: Show NSFW content
nsfw.hint: Adult extensions and sources stay hidden (repositories, browse, global search) until this is on.
nsfw.confirmDescription: Extensions and sources marked NSFW will show in repositories, browse and global search. Only turn this on if you are an adult and allowed to see such content.

autoUpdate.label: Update extensions by themselves
autoUpdate.hint: After a repository sync, updates install unless they reach new sites; those still ask.

syncEvery.label: Check repositories
syncEvery.hint: While online. Sync one now from its card.

browse.reposHint: Where extensions come from. Verified = signed with the official key.

reader.intro: Default display rules, reading direction, tap zones and keys. Changes save at once.
reader.defaultsHint: Used for every manga without its own settings.
reader.widthHint: Width of the strip in webtoon and vertical modes.
reader.gapHint: Space between pages in vertical mode.
reader.byTypeHint: What “Auto” reading mode and direction mean for each kind of manga.
reader.navigationHint: Tap zones for the mouse and touch screens, and the scroll wheel.
reader.invertZonesHint: Swap the previous and next zones.
reader.wheelHint: In page modes, the wheel turns the page once a tall page is scrolled to its edge.
reader.keysHint: Keys for turning pages, changing chapters and the reader controls.
reader.keysFooter: Keys can include Ctrl, Alt or Shift. Escape cancels while waiting for a key.
reader.keyTaken: {{key}} is already used by “{{action}}”. Remove it there first.
reader.displayHint: Colour filters over the pages, the page number and auto-scroll.
reader.warmHint: A sepia tone that is easier on the eyes at night.
reader.pageIndicatorHint: Show “page / total” while the bars are hidden.
reader.autoScrollHint: How fast the strip moves by itself (S or the button in the bottom bar).
reader.preloadHint: Pages loaded ahead of the one on screen.

discord.title: Discord
discord.enabled: Show what I read on Discord
discord.enabledHint: Rich Presence: “Reading <title> · <chapter>” while the reader is open. Never for adult sources or in incognito.

doh.title: DNS-over-HTTPS
doh.description: Look up site addresses over an encrypted connection, so a provider blocking sites through DNS (as many Indonesian ISPs do) cannot.

modes.automaticHint: Use DNS-over-HTTPS, and the system DNS when it does not answer.
modes.secureHint: Only DNS-over-HTTPS; sites stay unreachable when it does not answer.

doh.invalid: Enter an https:// URL; until then DNS-over-HTTPS stays off.

proxy.title: Proxy
proxy.description: Send all traffic (sources, images, repositories, updates) through a proxy.
proxy.passwordHint: Stored on this computer (encrypted where the system has a keyring) and never shown again. Used only when the proxy asks.
proxy.noKeyring: This system has no keyring: the password is stored unencrypted in the app's data folder.

userAgent.title: User-Agent
userAgent.description: How the app introduces itself to sites. An extension that sets its own (MangaDex does) keeps it.

test.title: Test connection
test.description: Loads a small page through these settings.

errors.rate_limited: Too many requests, slow down a little
errors.not_implemented: This source does not support that
errors.interrupted: The extension got stuck and was stopped
errors.memory: The extension ran out of memory
errors.host_crashed: The extension host restarted, try again
errors.not_installed: The extension for this source is not installed
errors.nsfw_hidden: Adult sources are hidden. Turn them on in Settings → Browse & extensions.

noResults.title: No results
noResults.description: Try another search or loosen the filters.

sources.hiddenByContent_one: {{count}} source hidden by your content settings.
sources.hiddenByContent_other: {{count}} sources hidden by your content settings.

openUrl.label: Open a manga from its web link
openUrl.placeholder: Paste a manga link, e.g. https://mangadex.org/title/…
openUrl.noMatch: No installed source recognises this link.

extensions.uninstallDescription: Its settings and saved data are removed. Manga from it stay in your library, marked "source not installed", until you install it again.
extensions.repoRemoved: Its repository was removed (no more updates)

noRepos.title: No repositories yet
noRepos.description: Extensions come from repositories. Add one by its URL to see what it offers.

allInstalled.title: Everything is installed
allInstalled.description: Every extension your repositories offer is already installed.

noUpdates.title: Everything is up to date
noUpdates.description: Repositories are checked once a day; sync one in the Repositories panel to check now.

repos.addDescription: The URL of an extension repository (the folder with index.json).
repos.unverifiedWarning: Extensions from it can reach the sites they list. Only add repositories you trust.
repos.removeDescription: Extensions installed from it stay installed but get no more updates.
repos.trustDescription: From now on this repository only syncs when its index is signed with this key:

problem.unknown-key: Signed with a key this app does not know.
problem.bad-signature: The signature does not match the index.

install.description: What this extension can do, before it is installed.
install.unverifiedWarning: This repository is not verified. Only install extensions you trust.
install.newDomainsWarning: Version {{to}} can reach sites that {{from}} could not (marked New).

extensions.hiddenByContent_one: {{count}} extension hidden by your content settings.
extensions.hiddenByContent_other: {{count}} extensions hidden by your content settings.

logs.description: Recent log lines, failed calls and requests of this extension.
logs.empty: Nothing logged yet. Use the extension (browse, open a manga) and lines appear here.

handoff.failed_other: {{names}} could not be installed from the official repository

handoff.waiting_other: {{names}} will be installed from the official repository
handoff.waitingHint: It used to come with Matane. It installs by itself once Matane is online; your library stays as it is.

manga.author: Author: {{name}}
manga.noChapters: This source has no chapters for this manga in its language.
manga.sourceMissingHint: The source no longer lists this chapter; it is kept for your progress.

scanlators.title: Scanlators
scanlators.description: Hide groups you don't want, and order them to choose which version of a chapter to read when several groups released it.
scanlators.priorityHint: The highest group with a release wins; others follow the group you read last, then the newest upload.
scanlators.noPriorityHint: No order: the next chapter uses the group you read last, else the newest upload. Move a group to set an order.

notFound.title: Chapter not found
notFound.description: It may have been removed from the source. Go back and refresh the manga.

transition.missing_one: {{count}} chapter may be missing before this one
transition.missing_other: {{count}} chapters may be missing before this one
transition.noNext: You are all caught up. There is no next chapter yet.

settings.title: Reader settings
settings.shiftHint: Show the first page alone so spreads line up
settings.cropBordersHint: Trim white or black margins off pages
settings.splitTallHint: Show very long strips in parts (smoother scrolling)
settings.globalHint: These settings apply to every manga without its own.
settings.saveForManga: Save as default for this manga
settings.mangaOverrideHint: Changes here apply to this manga only (tap zones stay global).

reader.autoScrollHint: Scroll by itself (S); a click or Space stops it
reader.pageSaveFailed: The image could not be saved
reader.pageCopyFailed: The image could not be copied

noMatches.title: Nothing here

noMatches.category: This category has no manga yet. Select manga in "All" and use "Set categories".

remove.description: Reading progress and history are kept; categories are cleared.

categories.dialogHint: Choose the categories for this manga.

history.subtitle: One entry per manga · last read first

limit.confirmDescription_other: Your downloads use {{used}} of the {{limit}} limit. Automatic downloads are stopped. Download these {{count}} chapters anyway?

page.cancelAllDescription: They leave the queue and their partly downloaded pages are deleted. Finished downloads stay.
page.detailsPages: {{done}} of {{total}} pages were downloaded; retrying fetches only the rest.
page.limitReached: Download size limit reached ({{used}} of {{limit}}). Automatic downloads are stopped; you can still download chapters yourself.

queue.description: Download chapters from a manga's chapter list; they show up here while they download.

completed.title: No finished downloads
completed.description: Chapters appear here once downloaded. "Clear completed" hides them here; the files stay.

errors.title: No errors

page.offline: Offline: the queue waits and carries on by itself once you're back online.

palette.placeholder: Search manga, pages, settings and actions…

languages.description: Sources and extensions in these languages are shown. You can change this later in Settings.

downloads.description: Chapters you download are kept here to read offline.

sources.description: Sources are extensions that bring manga from a website.
sources.none: No source in your languages yet.

stats.incognitoNote: Reading in incognito is never counted.

empty.title: Nothing read yet
empty.description: Read a chapter and your reading time, chapters and favourite genres show up here.

genres.title: Top genres
genres.description: Genres of the chapters you read

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Where the chapters you read come from

backup.title: Backup
backup.description: Your library, categories, progress, history, statistics, repositories, extension settings and app settings. Not the downloaded files.

auto.label: Automatic backup
auto.hint: The last 7 are kept; a missed one runs soon after the app opens.

backup.syncTip: Tip: a folder synced by Syncthing, Dropbox or OneDrive brings your backups to your other computers; restore them there with "Merge".

dialog.title: Restore a backup
dialog.missing: Not installed here: {{names}}. Their manga come back as "source not installed" until you install them.
dialog.mergeHint: Combine with what is here: read status and bookmarks from both, the furthest progress, every category. Nothing is removed.
dialog.replaceHint: Remove the current library first, then restore. A backup of what is here now is made first.
dialog.settings: Also restore the app settings (theme, reader, downloads…)
dialog.replaceSure: I understand that the current library, progress and history are replaced.
dialog.safety: Backing up what is here now…

summary.safety: The previous state was backed up to {{path}}
summary.missingHint: Install them to read these sources again; their settings from the backup come with them.
